purpose: Separate proven syntax failure from unsupported/environment UNKNOWN.
KNOWN_FALSE: Escape-aware unbalanced TeX braces after unsupported-command/environment screening; escaped braces and unescaped-percent comments handled.
Pinned supported-grammar parser raises specific missing-argument/script/alignment/delimiter error class listed in helper.
Supported MathML required arity invalid: mfrac/mroot must have2children; nonempty msqrt required.
Actual local Chrome DOM has MathML merror with normal Chrome exit; retain DOM/screenshot evidence.
UNKNOWN: Unsupported/unresolved command/environment, even if braces also unbalanced.
Absent renderer, timeout, browser/environment failure or missing bbox without proven input syntax error.
Explicit empty required arguments: grammar vs notation ambiguity unresolved.
READY_FOR_ACTUAL_RENDER preflight is conversion-only, pass=null until actual Chrome.
KNOWN_TRUE: Supported/resolved input and actual Chrome MathML Core render with nonempty bbox, no merror, screenshot and normal exit. Syntax/render support only, never semantics.
